publicEndpointBehavior: Publicly routable HTTP(S) peer endpoints remain supported and must use exact path /api/peer/onion with no query.
intentionalBreakingChanges: Runtime:AllowLoopbackPeerEndpoints=true now fails startup; loopback peers are always blocked.
An explicit Node:PublicPeerRpcEndpoint without exact /api/peer/onion path now fails local contact creation instead of advertising an unusable contact.
consumerActions: deep-devops must generate one exact allowlist per UAT xnode using stable container IPv4 addresses and real recipient router IDs.
deep-devops must set DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=UAT because the ASP.NET Core default is Production.
deep-devops must set Node__Network=uat and Runtime__PrivatePeerNetworkIdentity=uat on every UAT xnode.
deep-devops must advertise each private peer RPC endpoint with literal IPv4, exact peer port, and /api/peer/onion path.
Production overlays must keep the feature disabled and the allowlist empty.
